--- Page 9 --- DEDICATED TO MY PARENTS --- Page 10 --- AGANCHENGANI Songsaro ong'enggira obostarangko sea-jotachi ra- rakna jotton ka'giparangkon novel, drama theatre, articles ( nikrangra ) aro short stories minga.
Iano 'short stories' ko "DO'DE MESARAM" ine ra'gataha.
Short story-ni gimin anga angni Assamese ripeng saksao sing'oa ua ang- SINDHU DEKHAR NICHINA" ine aganaha.
Uni orto- ara “Bindu' - Tingtotsa aro “Sindhu' -- Dalgipa chibima ba sagal ong'a.

Iako A'chik ku'sikchi pe'ode "Tingtotsa chio Sagal- ko nikna man'a gita ong'a." Chongmotan, ku'sik ba kat- ta kan'dikachian pifak obostarangko parakna nangani gi- min anga ( ku'sik ba katta + kan'dik ) “"KU'ANDIK" rang- ko ia kitapo DO'DE MESARAM ine mingaha.
Poraisogiparang namnikgenma  naniniksojawa ua pilakan na'simangon panchaka.
Ia kiiapo janapgipa pilak obostarang chanchie banaigirarangsan ongaia.
SANGMA) Food Corporation of India, P.O.
Araimile, Tura, West Garo Hills, Meghalaya.
